text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Let's do start practice, please!
10 more reps!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's try from the outside gate next time!
Yeah, let's try from the outside gate this time!

text_block_list.text:
"The Tenno Sho (Autumn).
Because the run to the first bend is short on the Tokyo 2,000m course—"
Securing a good position quickly right after the start is super important.

Royce and Royce immersed herself
single-mindedly in her training.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Heh!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(I want to win, I want to win, I want to win, win, win!
I want to run a great race!!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(Still, what is it—what's it all for?
Why am I—)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(Do you want to be called...
the "Strongest"?)
And then—the day of the race.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...What a colorful lineup of runners we have here.
Truly worthy of the Tenno Sho (Autumn)."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: From her generation, Hayahide-san, Ticket-san, and Chitose O-san. And—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I can't just keep my eyes on my classmates today.
Because—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: There is an older generation—that must be surpassed.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
'Sup!
Shall we show 'em what upperclassmen pride looks like, Tannhauser?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Right?
It grew this big, Machitan♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's Royce-chan! Haaay!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san, Tannhauser-san,
I'm counting on you both.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
By the way... what kind of things
do you usually think about during a race, Tannhauser?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "Even if you ask me what kind, it's just like, this and that, you know?!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I just want to give it my usual best, I guess.
And then clutch it when it counts! That's all!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: (Tannhauser-san... She seems soft and airy at first glance, but she's got a strong core, which is why she always runs so well...)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(I'm the only one. I'm the only one who doesn't
understand my own "core." But...)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: On the stage of the historic Eight Major Races, the Tenno Sho (Autumn)—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"If I could beat this gorgeous lineup
full of unique personalities...
If I could... win!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
What? ...I'm getting chills!
This feeling is...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
“Still, you're right. For my own sake,
and for the future, I must succeed at all costs!”

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—I'll win! I want to win! I'll show them I can win!
I'll win and see what I'm truly made of!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: The one who receives the greatest applause will be me!
